title: Take Privacy BACK (PortMaster)
description:
Portmaster puts you back in control on both Windows and Linux. 

Every connection your device makes, every process phoning home, and every app leaking data in the background can be analyzed and controlled by YOU.

Kernel-level visibility means nothing can hide. You can block all outbound connections and control what you do and don't want to connect. Block connections per app, per port, per country, per protocol, and more. 

Portmaster is open source, fully auditable, and great for privacy. It is one of my favorite tools to date, and the free version has all the power you need to make some serious gains.

For educational purposes only.
